content.title: Live Performer Type Variant | One Adult Action per Color Module
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original performer with stable face, hair, outfit anchors and one compact identity symbol. Introduce no more than one exact short word per graphic module and pair it with one readable action. Let typography occupy foreground, floor, doorway or orbit while preserving the performer's identity. Escalate word scale and action amplitude without adding uncontrolled text or changing the module grammar. End by placing the same adult and original identity symbol inside one complete readable title card.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original performer with stable face, hair, outfit anchors and one compact identity symbol. + Introduce no more than one exact short word per graphic module and pair it with one readable action. + Let typography occupy foreground, floor, doorway or orbit while preserving the performer's identity. + Escalate word scale and action amplitude without adding uncontrolled text or changing the module grammar. + End by placing the same adult and original identity symbol inside one complete readable title card.
quick_start.recommended_input: On a navy field, establish one clearly adult Afro-Latina sign-language performer with a copper bob, teal jacket and one compact original hand-shaped emblem; lock face, hair and outfit. Move through a coral room with exact 'TURN' and a cyan room with exact 'REACH'; she performs one turn and one reach while each word crosses either foreground or floor, never both. The same adult steps into a navy title card; show the hand emblem above exact 'MARA SIGNS', stop all type and body motion and hold.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original performer with stable face, hair, outfit anchors and one compact identity symbol. Introduce no more than one exact short word per graphic module and pair it with one readable action. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original performer with stable face, hair, outfit anchors and one compact identity symbol.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Introduce no more than one exact short word per graphic module and pair it with one readable action.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Let typography occupy foreground, floor, doorway or orbit while preserving the performer's identity.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Escalate word scale and action amplitude without adding uncontrolled text or changing the module grammar.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: End by placing the same adult and original identity symbol inside one complete readable title card.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source young-looking dancer, face, hair, clothing and poses
source candy-color rooms, doors, stairs and stage
source HEY, WHO, FLY, JUMP, RUN, STEP, GLOW and name wording
source exact dance choreography, typography movement, camera path and timing
source creator identity, MiniMax H3 claim, watermark and branding
